cases.scenario: Client's age is less than 6 weeks: Client is not due for Hib vaccination
cases.guidance:
Should not vaccinate client with first Hib dose as client's age is less than 6 weeks. 
Check for any other vaccines due and inform the caregiver of when to come back for first dose.

cases.scenario: No Hib primary series doses were administered and Client's age is between 6 weeks and 5 years: Client is due for Hib vaccination
cases.guidance:
Should vaccinate client with first Hib dose as no Hib doses were administered and client is within appropriate age range. 
Check for contraindications.

cases.scenario: One Hib primary series dose was administered, Client's age is at least 6 weeks and not more than 5 years, Client's age was less than 1 year when first Hib dose was administered, and The latest Hib dose was administered less than 4 weeks ago: Client is not due for Hib vaccination
cases.guidance:
Should not vaccinate client with second Hib dose as latest Hib dose was administered less than 4 weeks ago. 
Check for any other vaccines due and inform the caregiver of when to come back for second dose.

cases.scenario: One Hib primary series dose was administered, Client's age is at least 6 weeks and not more than 5 years, Client's age was less than 1 year when first Hib dose was administered, and The latest Hib dose was administered more than 4 weeks ago: Client is due for Hib vaccination
cases.guidance:
Should vaccinate client with second Hib dose as client's age was less than 1 year when first Hib dose was administered and the latest Hib dose was administered more than 4 weeks ago. 
Check for contraindications.

cases.scenario: One Hib primary series dose was administered, Client's age is at least 6 weeks and not more than 5 years, and Client's age was more than 1 year when first Hib dose was administered: Hib immunization schedule is complete
cases.guidance:
Hib immunization schedule is complete as client's age was more than 1 year when first Hib dose was administered. One Hib primary series dose was administered.
Check for any other vaccines due.

cases.scenario: Two Hib primary series doses were administered, Client's age is between 6 weeks and not more than 5 years, and The latest Hib dose was administered less than 4 weeks ago: Client is not due for Hib vaccination
cases.guidance:
Should not vaccinate client with third Hib dose as latest Hib dose was administered less than 4 weeks ago. 
Check for any other vaccines due and inform the caregiver of when to come back for third dose.

cases.scenario: Two Hib primary series doses were administered, Client's age is between 6 weeks and not more than 5 years, and The latest Hib dose was administered more than 4 weeks ago: Client is due for Hib vaccination
cases.guidance:
Should vaccinate client with third Hib dose as client is within appropriate age range and latest Hib dose was administered more than 4 weeks ago. 
Check for contraindications.

cases.scenario: Three Hib primary series doses were administered: Hib immunization schedule is complete
cases.guidance:
Hib immunization schedule is complete. Three Hib primary series doses were administered. 
Check for any vaccines due.

cases.scenario: Client's age is more than 5 years: Client is not due for Hib vaccination
cases.guidance:
Should not vaccinate client with Hib dose as client is more than 5 years old and Hib vaccination is not required for healthy children aged over 5 years. 
Check for any other vaccines due.
